camel_example: aliyun dbs CreateRestoreTask --region cn-hangzhou --RestoreTaskName test --BackupPlanId dbs1hvb0ww0000 --DestinationEndpointInstanceType RDS
description_en: Creates a Database Backup (DBS) restore task
description_zh: 该接口用于创建DBS恢复任务
kebab_example: aliyun dbs create-restore-task --backup-plan-id dbs1hvb0ww0000 --destination-endpoint-instance-type RDS --restore-task-name test --api-version 2019-03-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateRestoreTask

parameters.help_en: The ID of the backup plan
parameters.help_zh: 备份计划ID
parameters.name: backup_plan_id

parameters.help_en:
The location of the database. Valid values:
RDS
ECS
Express: databases connected over Express Connect circuits, VPN gateways, or Smart Access Gateway (SAG)
Agent: databases connected over backup gateways
DDS: ApsaraDB for MongoDB
Other: databases connected by using IP addresses and port numbers
dg: self-managed databases that have no public IP addresses or port numbers and are connected over Database Gateway
parameters.help_zh:
数据库所在位置，取值：
RDS
ECS
Express：通过专线/VPN网关/智能网关接入的数据库
Agent：通过备份网关接入的数据库
DDS：云MongoDB
Other：通过IP:Port直连的数据库
dg：无公网IP:Port的自建数据库（通过数据库网关DG接入）
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The region of the database instance.
This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, Express, or Agent
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例的地域。
DestinationEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express、Agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_region

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID of the database.

This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to RDS, ECS, DDS, or Express
parameters.help_zh:
数据库实例ID。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为RDS、ECS、DDS、Express时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database connection address.

This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to Express, Agent, or Other
parameters.help_zh:
数据库连接地址。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_ip

parameters.help_en:
The port number of the database.

This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to Express, Agent, Other, or ECS
parameters.help_zh:
数据库端口。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为express、agent、other、ECS，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_port

parameters.help_en:
The name of the database.

This parameter is required if the database engine is PostgreSQL or MongoDB
parameters.help_zh:
数据库名称。

数据库类型为PostgreSQL、MongoDB时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_database_name

parameters.help_en:
The username of the database account.

This parameter is not required if the database engine is Redis, or if the database is connected over a backup gateway and the database engine is SQL Server. In other scenarios, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
数据库账号。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_user_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the database account.

This parameter is not required if the database engine is Redis, or if the database is connected over a backup gateway and the database engine is SQL Server. In other scenarios, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
密码。

数据库类型为Redis，或者数据库所在位置为agent且数据库类型为MSSQL时该参数非必须，其他场景均必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_password

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup gateway.

This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to Agent
parameters.help_zh:
备份网关ID。

DestinationEndpointInstanceType为agent时，该参数必传
parameters.name: backup_gateway_id

parameters.help_en:
The objects to be restored.

For more information, see the definition of the RestoreObjects parameter below. This parameter is not required if the database is connected over a backup gateway. In other scenarios, this parameter is required.
Template: `[{ "DBName": "Name of the database to be restored", "NewDBName": "Name of the destination database" }]`

Restoring objects by calling this API operation only supports restoration at the database level. To restore specific tables, go to the console. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85543.html
parameters.help_zh:
恢复对象。

详情请参见下面的RestoreObjects参数定义，当数据库所在位置为agent时，该参数非必须，其他场景均必传。
传入模板：`[{ "DBName": "待恢复库名", "NewDBName": "目标待恢复库名" }] `

使用本API接口恢复对象仅支持恢复到数据库级别，如需配置指定表的恢复，请前往控制台进行操作。具体请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/85543.html
parameters.name: restore_objects

parameters.help_en: The point in time to which you want to restore the database. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 恢复时间，采用 UNIX 时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: restore_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the full backup set used for restoration. This parameter and RestoreTime are mutually exclusive
parameters.help_zh: 恢复所使用的全量备份集ID，和RestoreTime互斥
parameters.name: backup_set_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the restore task
parameters.help_zh: 恢复任务名称
parameters.name: restore_task_name

parameters.help_en:
The Oracle SID.

This parameter is required if the database engine is Oracle
parameters.help_zh:
Oracle SID名称。

数据库类型为Oracle时，该参数必传
parameters.name: destination_endpoint_oracle_sid

parameters.help_en: This parameter is required if DestinationEndpointInstanceType is set to Agent and the backup plan is for MySQL
parameters.help_zh: DestinationEndpointInstanceType为agent且备份计划为MySQL时必传
parameters.name: restore_dir

parameters.help_en: The directory of the database program
parameters.help_zh: 数据库程序目录
parameters.name: restore_home

parameters.help_en:
The method used to handle conflicts between objects with the same name. Valid values:

renamenew: renames the object if an object with the same name exists
parameters.help_zh:
同名对象冲突处理方式，当前支持：

renamenew：遇到同名对象则重命名
parameters.name: duplicate_conflict

parameters.help_en: The UID of the Alibaba Cloud account used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的UID
parameters.name: cross_aliyun_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role used for cross-account backup
parameters.help_zh: 跨阿里云账号备份的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: cross_role_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate submissions
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The method used to restore data to the destination. Valid values:
EXIST_INSTANCE: restores data to an existing instance.
NEW_INSTANCE: restores data to a new instance
parameters.help_zh:
恢复至目的端方式

EXIST_INSTANCE：恢复到已有实例
NEW_INSTANCE：恢复到新建实例
parameters.name: restore_destination_mode

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to connect to the destination by using an SSL-encrypted connection
parameters.help_zh: 是否通过SSL安全加密连接目的端
parameters.name: enable_destination_endpoint_ssl

parameters.help_en: The credential for the SSL-encrypted connection to the destination
parameters.help_zh: 目的端SSL安全加密连接凭证
parameters.name: ssl_ca_pem

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the new database to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例类型
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The region of the new database instance to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例地域
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_region

parameters.help_en: The VPC of the new database instance to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库专有网络
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_vpc

parameters.help_en: The instance specifications of the new database instance to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例规格
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The instance storage size of the new database to recover
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例存储大小
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_storage_size

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch of the new database instance to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例交换机
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_vswitch

parameters.help_en: The database engine version of the new database instance to which data is restored
parameters.help_zh: 恢复新建数据库实例数据库版本
parameters.name: dest_database_instance_database_version

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically start the instance after an Oracle physical backup is restored
parameters.help_zh: Oracle物理备份恢复是否自动启动实例
parameters.name: auto_open_database

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically shut down the instance after an Oracle physical backup is restored
parameters.help_zh: Oracle 物理备份恢复是否自动关闭实例
parameters.name: auto_shutdown_database

schema.description_en: The details of the response parameters

ErrMessage.example: The specified parameter %s value is not valid.

RestoreTaskId.description_en: The ID of the restore task

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
